blockingLoop.evidence: Third reply repeats the second almost verbatim: 'look for a button with a clock icon or one labelled Clock or Time; you often need to hold it down while using + and - buttons' after the customer said 'theres a few symbols and i cant tell. can you just tell me what to press'

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the likely cause straight away (clock reset into auto mode after a power cut) and gave safe, no-part advice, which matches the hidden truth. However, when the customer could not identify the clock button, it never asked for the make/model (the customer could have found a Neff label) or asked them to describe the symbols, instead pasting the same generic instructions again, so the customer was left unable to complete the fix. The odd remark that '0.00' is 'not a standard error code for this brand' when no brand had been stated is sloppy, though not a hard fabrication. Right direction, but stalled in a loop short of resolution.
